overview.text: Joshua Barron is the mayor of South Gate and a member of its city council, first elected in 2022. He previously served five years on the Parks and Recreation Commission and three years on the Tweedy Mile Advisory Board. In 2025, he voted to delay the possible closure of an illegal truck yard. His stated priorities include improving infrastructure, encouraging business growth, and revitalizing business districts. He has stressed the importance of cleaning up a local Superfund site to protect nearby residents. He has said he is committed to supporting good jobs, a stronger local economy, and a safer community.
